name: eggd_swap-compare
title: RNA-swap identity QC: compare DNA site list against an RNA BAM
summary: Run GATK ASEReadCounter for one prepared DNA site list against one RNA BAM and classify the result

inputSpec.name: site_vcf
inputSpec.label: Prepared DNA germline site VCF (GRCh38, capture-restricted)
inputSpec.help: The site_vcf output of eggd_swap-prep-dna-vcf for one DNA sample. Used as both -V and -L for ASEReadCounter.

inputSpec.name: rna_bam
inputSpec.label: PanCan RNA BAM (GRCh38)
inputSpec.help: STAR-aligned, duplicate-marked RNA BAM for the candidate matched (or suspected-swap candidate) specimen.

inputSpec.name: reference_fasta
inputSpec.label: GRCh38 reference FASTA
inputSpec.help: The exact GRCh38 reference used to align rna_bam (e.g. the CTAT reference used by STAR/Eunomia) -- must be the same reference used to prepare site_vcf.

inputSpec.name: gatk_jar
inputSpec.label: GATK jar (ASEReadCounter)
inputSpec.help: Provided directly as a file input rather than resolved through an asset-selection manifest, to keep this app free of any manifest/candidate/validation-mode indirection. The caller is responsible for supplying the correct, fixed GATK build every time.

inputSpec.name: dna_sample_id
inputSpec.label: DNA sample/specimen identifier (label only)
inputSpec.help: Used only to label comparison_report_json for human readability. Never used for pairing/discovery logic -- the caller is responsible for supplying the correct site_vcf/rna_bam pair.
